## The Waiting game

Bourbon-making is an exercise in patience &

perseverance. Out of the millions of barrels


aging in Kentucky, only a small fraction are

allowed to age as long as 18-Year-Old.

[EXPLORE](https://elijahcraig.com/our-whiskey.php)

In the beginning, we don’t

know which barrels will be

worthy of consideration. But

time & expertise will tell.

[![arrow icon](https://elijahcraig.com/images/angle-round.svg)](https://elijahcraig.com/our-whiskey.php)

As they age, our barrels are

meticulously sampled by our

master tasters. Even after 18

years, some barrels won’t

meet their high standards.

[![arrow icon](https://elijahcraig.com/images/angle-round.svg)](https://elijahcraig.com/18-year-old#)

Each single barrel is then

individually dumped &

bottled. The barrel number

& bottling date is handwritten

on the label.

[![arrow icon](https://elijahcraig.com/images/angle-round.svg)](https://elijahcraig.com/18-year-old#)

## TASTING NOTES 18-YEAR-OLD

“Vanilla fudge, honey and orchard fruits, such as cherries, flood your senses. The nose on this
bourbon is invigorating and swirls with complexity."

### BLAIR PHILLIPS, DISTILLER.COM

### Color:

Warm, deep leather

### AROMA:

Aged oak, spiced vanilla, with notes of mint and chocolate

### Taste:

Richly textured, nutty, and semisweet. Initial

bursts

of honey give way to toasted
wood

and pleasant char

### Finish:

Lively and engaging, then lingers

with vanilla and pepper.

### Proof:

90 Proof

## I'm so disappointed!!!

So very disappointed! This is the second time in my life that I've bought EC 18yr. The first time was not great either but after years I had the opportunity to buy an 18 from our state liquor store in PA and thought I'd try it again. It's actually worse now. I sincerely don't understand how HH can p...ut out a product like this. I've been drinking bourbon for decades. This 18yr is like brown wood water. I swear I'll never buy another HH product again! Not even a bottle of McKenna 10. I think I'm done for good with you guys. I blame myself too. 7-11-25 bottle date 7442 barrel
